title: Enzymatic fingerprinting of AX and  mixed-linked BG
author: Alison Lovegrove

steps_raw.instruction: Protocol for Enzymatic Fingerprinting of AX and MLG in wheat flour
100 mg of flour is weighed in an Eppendorf tube (2ml; safe-lock).
One mL of 80% EtOH is added and vortexed. The mixture is boiled in heat block for 10 minutes. (Secure the lids of Eppendorf tubes with clamps otherwise they will pop open.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 12,000 rpm (or 5 minutes at 10,000 rpm).
Pour off the supernatant and wash the residue with 1 ml of 80% EtOH. The pellet may be compacted, so resuspend with micro-spatula ensuring no sample is lost. tube. Vortex.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 12,000 rpm.
Pour off the supernatant and wash the residue with 1 ml of 95% EtOH. (Again, ensuring the pellet is resuspended using a micro-spatula. Vortex.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 12,000 rpm.
Pour off the supernatant and dry the residue in SpeedVac. ~ 2 hrs.
Resuspend the washed flour in a total of 1 mL reaction solution, containing 2 µL of Xyn11 (or Xyn10) and 0.95 µL of lichenase (-glucanase)/ sample.

NB Make up a stock for the number of samples you are going to digest, avoiding multiple additions of small volumes of enzyme. I.E. for 24 samples make up a total volume of 25ml enzyme solution, containing 50ul xylanase and 23.75ul lichenase, mix and dispense 1ml to each tube.
Incubate digests for 16 h @ 40 ºC and 850 rpm in Thermomixer (Overnight). (or oven with tumbling)
Spin down digest, 5 minutes at 12,000 rpm.
Recover 0.6 mL of supernatant (taking care not to pipette the residue) into a new Eppendorf tube.
Boil for 30 minutes in heat block to inactivate enzymes. (Put clamp on!).
Centrifuge for 2 min at 12,000 rpm.
Filter supernatant into a new Eppendorf tube using 0.45 µm Millex-HV syringe driven filter on Terumo 2 ml syringes.

A dilution (1/20) of the supernatant is required for injection onto the HPAEC system running CarboPac PA1 column. (1/20 dilution: add 50 µl of the filtered supernatant and 950 µl diluted Internal standard (10M melibiose) into glass vials with polyethylene snap cap.
Mix with pipetting up and down.
Always process and run a standard Hereward flour sample (flour stored aliquoted in freezer Hereward defatted white flour) with each new set of samples.
